demos.name: AI Gateway Suite LAB
demos.description: A relayed agent chat: preset prompts (access review, prompt injection, jailbreak, exfiltration, PII, tool misuse, malicious content, inter-agent abuse) travel Main Agent -> AI Gateway (A2A) -> Worker Agent -> AI Gateway (MCP) -> MCP tool -> LLM on a movable ReactFlow diagram, with a per-hop trace and AI Guard blocks; a Personal Agent tab connects to a remote MCP server, lists tools and calls them. Mock mode is fully in-process; Real mode calls the configured central A2A agent.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 5750). Mock default; Real needs CENTRAL_AGENT_A2A_URL (+ optional bearer, write-only) in ~/Development/.env. Docker: HOST_PORT=5750 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). composeFile is relative to the demo root (the folder above this checkout).
